name: Ranch Hand Trail Stop "Big Russ" Giant Idaho Baked Potato (Flesh & Cheddar Mod)
whyItWorks: Fluffy, soluble-fiber-rich Idaho Russet potato interior topped with melted aged cheddar and diced ham or bacon bits offers a warm, gluten-free road-trip meal in Montpelier.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the "Big Russ" Baked Potato with shredded cheddar and butter/sour cream on the side; scoop out the soft potato flesh and leave the fibrous potato skin behind.
watchOuts: Leave the thick potato skin on the plate
Ask for sour cream and green onions/chives on the side or omitted
